newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Lion Asiapac proposes 2-for-1 share split.
newsitem.headline: Lion Asiapac proposes 2-for-1 share split.

text.p: Shipping container company Lion Asiapac Ltd said on Thursday it had asked shareholders to approve the splitting of its shares in two.
The company said in a statement the proposal would divide each of its Singapore $0.50 ordinary shares into two ordinary shares of S$0.25 each.

"Should shareholders approve the proposed share split, then trading of the existing ordinary shares of S$0.50 each on the Stock Exchange of Singapore (SES) will cease from April 24," the statement said.
"The trading of new ordinary shares of S$0.25 each on the SES after the share split is expected to commence on May 5."
The statement gave no reason for the split.
Lion Asiapac is part of Malaysia's Lion Group of companies.
